data.gender_notes: Barcot is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'bar-kotos', meaning 'son of a bear'. In the New Testament, Bartholomew is identified as Nathanael, which means 'given by God'. Therefore, Barcot can be interpreted as 'son given by God, like a bear'. The name Barcot carries the meaning “Son of a bear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Barcot usually hope their child will grow to embody son of a bear and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Barcot total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
